published_mixing.disposition: Omitted: previously documented executable is absent and no research runtime will be installed. This limits comparative positioning, not correctness evidence.

measurement_notes: Wall time includes the whole public API call, including its built-in certificate checks. Separate-process verification time is recorded separately.
Requested time limits are cooperative. Record actual overrun; process watchdog is not a solver deadline.
Peak RSS is process high-water memory including imported dependencies. CPU seconds include solver worker and its exited child workers during the API call.
LP native controls use highspy simplex and ipm from the identical linked HiGHS version; numerical objectives and feasibility tolerances are checked, not represented as exact proofs.
Basic SDP uses the same current public solver with relaxation=sdp; this is an internal baseline, not an independent published solver.
Existing diagnostic fields are recorded verbatim. Missing fallback telemetry is null, never inferred as no fallback.
Exhaustive-oracle and heuristic energies are independently recomputed from saved inputs and binary assignments. Exact bounds/gaps are retained as rational strings.
Generated synthetic inputs and Pegasus couplings are frozen in the corpus before measured runs; downloaded G57 is hashed. Candidate source hashes identify the actual measured files.

Pre-run code inspection found explicit LP budgets bypass acceleration. LP comparisons therefore run without solver deadlines, with a 180-second process watchdog, allowing portfolio/row-recovery behavior to be measured. LP budgets are null and overruns are not applicable.
Pre-measurement review replaced SciPy LP controls with highspy native controls to remove bundled-HiGHS version differences. No performance observations preceded this change.
